WFCAT-001.note: Reuses only approved PCA action IDs for seven existing native actions; all 436 ledger mappings/action authorities and approval remain Required.

WFCAT-002.note: Configured captures freeze workflow ID/name/type/actions/chooser intent, use existing pipeline task IDs/timings/results, and retain safe snapshot metadata in private journals. Full invocation origin/settings/acquisition-failure coverage remains Required. Effective output folder/pattern now freeze before acquisition and remain in known-field result/journal/retry snapshots. Explicit-ID invocation freezes the saved profile/output at primary admission before acknowledgement. Private portal/controller evidence proves original output after a profile edit, then changed output on the next invocation. Activation request ID is not the pipeline task ID; origin/result linkage remains Required. Desktop shortcut activation now reaches the same workflow-ID admission snapshot and actual controller as Run selected/CLI. Synthetic private-portal output evidence verifies saved settings and actual PNG pixels; full execution-origin/task/result linkage remains Required. Admitted region captures now durably record request/execution UUID, admission start, trusted boundary origin and frozen effective settings before ACK/acquisition; early denial/cancellation/source failure and actual pipeline terminal/order are linked to a separate task ID. Canonical/private PCA metadata links back to the execution. Headless read-only lookup reports nonterminal observations as unconfirmed without querying runtime. Full families/settings, retry invocation indexing, retention and target/human gates remain Required.

WFCAT-003.note: Explicit full-UUID CLI activation now shares the authenticated dispatcher and actual controller with Run selected. Read-only workflow IDs are available in the manager. Global hotkeys, discovery, MCP/watch-folder/automation entry points remain Required. Explicit session global shortcut Enable/Configure/Disable now uses supported saved workflow IDs and the shared dispatcher/controller. Desktop chooses keys; held repeats are suppressed. Saving/reloading workflows disables obsolete session bindings. Persisted opt-in, full catalogue, MCP/watch-folder/automation and all target/human qualification remain Required. Read-only CLI discovery now supplies saved IDs/default/definition support for normal full-UUID execution without GUI initialization or primary activation. Saved disk scope and unqueried runtime state are explicit; the running primary still admits execution independently. Invocation/execution/result correlation, full interface families and shared schemas remain Required. Default/choose-actions, explicit-ID, native-shell and accepted shortcut capture admission now share request-aware Core preparation and controller execution observations. Headless execution lookup is read-only. All other entry points and shared schemas remain Required. Built-in global shortcuts route through shared shell QActions and capture admission. A single portal plan includes workflow UUIDs and capture IDs; preferred triggers never override desktop authority. Full interface coverage and human qualification remain Required.

WFCAT-004.note: Configured supported actions retain existing PCA succeeded/failed/skipped/cancelled and interruption facts; unavailable definitions fail before acquisition. Complete workflow status taxonomy/families remain Required. Region execution records now distinguish early permission-denied, cancelled, failed and undispatched not-started; actual PCA receipts supply succeeded/partial/cancelled/interrupted states. Missing terminal durability or in-flight destruction remains outcome-unconfirmed. Full family status taxonomy remains Required.

WFCAT-005.note: Saved selections use the existing normative PCA engine order and independent/dependent failure policy. Remaining post-upload/action families remain Required.

WFCAT-006.note: Configured runs use existing observable controller/pipeline cancellation and retain their frozen profile in results/retry. Full family cancellation/cleanup matrices remain Required. Early portal/selection/composition cancellation is durable without inventing a pipeline. Failed admission/start/link persistence blocks the next boundary; terminal write failure keeps completed outputs and reports unconfirmed storage. Full family cancellation/cleanup remains Required.

WFCAT-007.note: Named region profiles use the existing portal/overlay permission and capture path, with pre-acquisition validation. Mixed-display/DPI/cursor/HDR/recording scope and human permission review remain Required.

WFCAT-008.note: Profiles select existing image/file/path clipboard outputs; actual native GUI dispatch and saved-file prerequisites remain shared. Other clipboard input/format workflows and full privacy/target qualification remain Required.

WFCAT-009.note: Existing save/new-PNG/file-reveal validation and authority are reused. Workflow configuration is private/atomic, detects external changes and confirms profile deletion. Other file/folder/index/external/destructive families remain Required. Profiles now save absolute folders and portable filename patterns. Folder validation rejects relative/traversal/control input; production Save validates before I/O and retains no-replacement collisions. Native picker and independent failure behavior are verified; complete filesystem/authority review remains Required.

WFCAT-010.note: Native capture/file/watch uploads and URL clipboard use destination/keyring/executor paths with real fixture tests. Complete remote authority, credentials, progress/retry/idempotency and all workflow families remain.

WFCAT-011.note: Profiles can invoke the existing region-image annotation/output path. OCR/QR/hash/combine/split/effects/tools and complete family input/metadata schemas remain Required.

WFCAT-012.note: RecordingController validates start/pause/resume/stop/abort and region/audio paths with tests. Full saved recording workflow definitions, invocation indexing, concurrent control/recovery and target qualification remain.

WFCAT-013.note: Run Selected checks capture availability and current modal work, and uses an immutable saved definition. Full application-control/headless-authority behaviors remain Required. --non-interactive refuses graphical operations before QApplication/display, election, preference initialization or portal consent. No headless execution authority is added. Full application-control/headless operation coverage remains Required. Shortcut setup refuses busy/modal configuration. Disable cancels pending setup without cancelling a running capture. The desktop owns shortcut consent; owner loss never auto-rebinds. Full application-control/headless authority and lifecycle qualification remain Required.

WFCAT-014.note: Configured captures preserve existing single-controller busy arbitration and worker snapshots; changes affect future runs. Full concurrency policies across all resources and entry points remain Required. Workflow admission reserves a single pending operation and snapshots saved settings; busy/modal conflicts and preparation reentry fail without acquisition. Late conflicts release the reservation. Choose-actions now uses ordinary dispatch so subsequent workflows can run. Full resource/concurrency policy remains Required. Pending desktop binding blocks conflicting capture admission; bound presses use existing single-operation admission and are never queued. Repeats remain held through a refused busy press until release. Binding updates preserve held accepted keys; disable/invalidation clears authority. All-resource concurrency policies remain Required. Request-aware preparation persists only after existing busy/modal checks. Normal abandoned/late-busy dispatch records not-started and duplicate/stale private IDs cannot overwrite or restart captures. Complete arbitration remains Required.

WFCAT-015.note: Explicit retained retry keeps the original workflow snapshot and successful outputs after profile edits; no configuration reread/repeat is introduced. Other idempotency/remote families remain Required. Retained save retry now proves original folder/pattern use after the profile destination/name changes. Private activation UUID/payload receipts prevent duplicate dispatch within the bounded primary lifetime; changed workflow payload with the same request ID is rejected and missing acknowledgement never auto-resends. This does not establish durable exactly-once or remote idempotency. Explicit retained retries preserve original execution metadata plus independent pipeline attempt lineage; complete retry invocation/execution indexing and all-family idempotency remain Required.

WFCAT-016.note: Native-only v1 profiles use UUIDs and existing PCA IDs; validate bounded definitions/default membership before execution; preserve unknown compatible fields/actions; reject corrupt/newer/unsupported execution and detect stale writes. Shared interchange/migration/import/presets and compatibility/human review remain Required. Private v2 output definitions read v1 default semantics and upgrade only on explicit Save. Unknown v1 output authority is refused/preserved; nested compatible v2 output fields round-trip. Native unsupported counters/file reads are explicit. The private v1 activation protocol adds strict workflow_id-only run-workflow and payload-free capture-region-choose-actions names; older instances reject unknown actions. Saved-definition resolution now lives in the QtCore domain store. No shared interchange/schema acceptance is claimed. Shortcut projection validates the existing native profile format and offers supported canonical UUID/name pairs only. Returned subsets cannot introduce unknown or duplicate IDs or override profile actions/settings. No persisted/shared format or compatibility authority changes. The native GUI and discovery share one Core implemented-action list, domain store and native path helper. Listing preserves v1/unknown/current bytes, creates no settings for initial defaults, validates private storage and rejects a changed snapshot rather than printing stale partial data. Persisted/shared schema semantics are unchanged.

WFCAT-017.note: Results and private restart journals retain a known-field-only workflow snapshot and existing truthful outcomes. Unknown extensions are excluded from reports. Full notifications/log/privacy/terminal-state convergence remains Required. Nested output extensions are excluded from reports while known private folder/pattern fields stay available to explicit review. Versioned CLI JSON contains admission/delivery, stable errors and valid opaque IDs only; it does not publish private names/actions/folders/patterns or claim terminal output success. Complete result convergence and execution/result lookup remain Required. The native command window reports actual desktop binding descriptions/empty results and fixed setup failures as plain accessible text; registration does not claim capture success. Full terminal-state convergence, origin/result linkage and human privacy/accessibility qualification remain Required. Explicit discovery reveals saved workflow IDs/names and fixed definition diagnostics while excluding private output fields, action choices and unknown extensions/capture labels. It creates no execution ID or terminal-success claim and queries no runtime permissions. Complete execution/result linkage, privacy and shared convergence remain Required. Explicit headless lookup reports only IDs, trusted origin, times, ordered action/state pairs, fixed diagnostics and pipeline link. Known private settings stay in owner-only execution storage; canonical history/report includes execution reference. Unfinished/failed-persistence observations remain unconfirmed, completed outputs are kept. Full convergence, retention and human privacy/security review remain Required.

WFCAT-018.note: Core/native UI/restart/real-output/private-portal cases cover the supported profile slice. No published WORKFLOW vectors exist; CMake reports that absence explicitly, following CORE precedent. All approved action-family vectors, platform adapters and human activation gates remain Required. Core protocol/dispatcher, actual child application and private-portal real-controller tests now cover workflow-ID admission, safe JSON, headless refusal, profile snapshots, failure/busy/unknown delivery and reservation release. Published WFCAT vectors, full target matrix and human gates remain Required. New private-bus Core/native-action/actual-controller tests cover early/normal replies, wrong owner/session/ID, held keys and changes, denial/cancellation/unavailability/timeout, invalid bindings, late cleanup, replacement/session loss, busy refusal and synthetic real PNG output. Published WFCAT vectors and all supported desktop/human acceptance gates remain Required. Core projection/stale/privacy tests and actual headless child application cases cover initial/saved/v1/unavailable/corrupt/newer/unsafe/symlink storage, busy primary without activation, conflicting/invalid arguments and help without display or preference writes. Full action-family scenarios, published WFCAT vectors and target/human gates remain Required. Additional Core/native/private-portal/actual-app tests verify new-primary and forwarded ACK-to-denial lookup, real PNG link-before-output, early denial/cancel/failure/destruction, admission/start/link/terminal storage faults, duplicates/stale/unsafe/malformed/future records and headless read-only CLI. All published vectors and target/human acceptance gates remain unchanged.
